name: serpin family A member 1

function.text: SERPINA1 encodes alpha-1-antitrypsin [Cleaved into: Short peptide from AAT]. Annotated molecular activities include serine-type endopeptidase inhibitor activity and protease binding.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to alpha 1-antitrypsin deficiency (autosomal recessive).
